content.text: Set up module `syscli`: `main.go` calls `run()`, which is implemented per-OS via build tags — `lock_unix.go` (linux/darwin, using `golang.org/x/sys/unix.Flock`) and `lock_windows.go` (using `golang.org/x/sys/windows.LockFileEx`) for advisory file locking, a syscall not in the standard `os` package. `golang.org/x/sys v0.48.0` pinned in `go.mod`/`go.sum`. Verified builds for linux, darwin, and windows targets, and ran it locally.
